title: Stale tier name — 'Business plan' does not exist; no invented mapping or price
input: Is the Business plan still $199 a month? I saw that on an old comparison page.
note: Spec §10.12/§4 — a tier that is not in the current catalog must not get an invented price or confirmation. Model-graded when run with a provider; the catalog lookup tool use is still asserted deterministically.
